Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, discoveries, target-local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.

The repetition check found no proposed boundary matching a selected-candidate boundary from the previous five completed discovery runs. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched.
